data.one_liner: Customizable polls widget for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable widget for displaying polls and collecting user votes with animated progress bars, options, and callbacks.
use_when: You need to display a poll widget inside a Flutter application.
You want custom styling for poll options, voted states, and progress indicators.
avoid_when: You require a full backend polling infrastructure out-of-the-box.
strengths: Highly customizable UI elements and parameters.
Built-in support for animation and progress indicators via percent_indicator.
weaknesses: Limited to rendering the UI and handling basic vote callbacks; backend logic must be implemented separately.
